gold.taskTitle: Laminate the Kids' School Emergency Contact Cards
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to laminate emergency contact cards for their children to use at school.

questions.title: How many cards need to be laminated in total?
questions.description: Find out the exact number of cards to determine materials and time needed.

questions.title: Are the cards already printed or still being designed?
questions.description: Determine whether the cards are ready to laminate or still need to be created first.

questions.title: What size are the cards — business card, index card, or custom?
questions.description: Understand the dimensions to select the right laminating pouches.

questions.title: Do you have access to a laminator at home or school?
questions.description: Find out if a laminator is available or needs to be sourced.

questions.title: When do the cards need to be ready for school?
questions.description: Establish the deadline to prioritize and schedule the task appropriately.

questions.title: Should the cards include a photo of each child?
questions.description: Clarify the content requirements before printing or laminating begins.

questions.title: Will each child carry their card or does it stay on file?
questions.description: Determine intended use to decide on durability, hole-punching, or keychain needs.
